newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal unlikely to cut repo Monday.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal unlikely to cut repo Monday.

text.p: None of the six economists at Lisbon banks and brokerages polled by Reuters believed the central bank would cut its key money market rates on Monday.
The Bank of Portugal will announce its terms for the next commercial bank reserves period on Monday although they will only come into effect after the Christmas break on Thursday.
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo next week?
2. Will the central bank cut other rates next week?
3. Is there room to lower rates further in the future?
The following contributors agreed to be identified -- Siemca, Banco de Comercio e Industria, Banco Mello Comercial, Banco Finantia and Fincor.
